summary: Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. filed a Form 6-K with minutes of a Board meeting held June 2, 2026, calling an Extraordinary General Meeting for July 2, 2026, to fix the number of board members and elect two new directors. The meeting is a routine governance step to refresh the board composition; no forced or abrupt departure is disclosed. As a non-US filing, this 6-K reports a board governance action. The filing does not state any terms, advisors, or premium. What to watch: the specific appointments at the EGM and any strategic shift they may signal.
